source_conclusions.finding: Old aliases are processed before sorting/compaction. New staged registrations are outside oldAliases prefix and retain authority. Logical any-byte overlap invalidates old4-byte word. Physical-only overlap retains opaque current native value. Serial latest-wins compaction preserves invalid tombstones.

Two removed index intervals yield at most3 surviving fragments per old byte/array segment; reserved3N+1 covers fragments and new segment. Physical and logical overlap cut partial expanded elements. Opaque expanded object partial overwrite retires object-address mapping.

Reserve and assign occur before native stores; current active owned words captured with memcpy. Retained words never reread stale slots. Reserve overflow and sequence headroom checked. Capture does not depend on initial raw tag value.
Found null remains distinct from missing via state result. Retained values bypass stale pointer dereference. External slots classified without reading external memory.
TEMP conversion permits only Active/Retained and uses explicit Com_Error for Missing/Invalid/External. NonTEMP legacy fallback retained.
TEMP MapLookup requires owned exact segment; no drift fallback can revive overwritten coordinates.
Single staged disk read prepares before native stores, reader exception clears private disk provenance and cancels untouched ownership; envelope cancels before external stores.
Direct Load_Stream and null-terminated loader prepare before writes and poison existing owned metadata for caught C++ exceptions.
Init clears pending capture, aliases, segment history and sequence between zones.

limits_and_gaps.finding: Controlled retained-value cases currently use marker pointers. Found-null and unresolved sentinel/ordinary encoded-word retention deserve explicit cases; source preserves bits correctly by inspection.
Null-terminated decoder callback aborts; no current controlled TEMP C-string success/partial-failure test exercises actual hook.
No direct staged duplicate newest registration/tombstone mask case in current controlled matrix. Serial compaction appears correct by inspection.

Unprepared bare TEMP IncStreamPos prepares after caller and treats reservation as overwrite. No ordinary production bare block0 caller found: InsertPointer usesblock4; arithmetic-only old stream-init fixtures intentionally map but do not prove byte overwrite semantics.

Pointer stores/registration occur outside scratch reader catch. Prepared disk-word capacity and sequence headroom avoid allocations for audited normal fields; unexpected late budget/sequence/commit exceptions are not a general atomic recovery guarantee.

Cancel(true) invalidates existing owned metadata rather than setting persistent global poison. Later successful writes may establish new authority before reset. Comment until-reset is stronger than actual state behavior.

Actual Com_Error uses longjmp, bypassing C++ catches. Production async corrupt/refill error cleanup is not certified by controlled thrown errors. The staged reader assigns accumulator only after success, so a read longjmp alone does not leave a nonzero accumulator; general late-poststore nonlocal exits and private provenance lifetime are not certified.

Verifier establishes selected Win32 leaves and unchanged expander bodies/reversible scoped edits. It explicitly does not certify native semantics or compiler preprocessing. No memory allocation-failure or no-allocation-runtime proof is present.
